obligations.title: Mobile Resource and Contact Scraping Prohibition
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.clause: Clause 10.2: Collection, Usage and Sharing of Borrower Data
obligations.statutory_rule: DLAs are explicitly prohibited from accessing mobile phone resources, including file and media storage, contact lists, phonebooks, call logs, and telephony functions.
obligations.remediation_advice: Remove all clauses granting access to borrower contacts, call logs, or media files. Limit mobile permissions strictly to one-time camera/microphone/location access for onboarding and KYC with prior explicit consent.

obligations.title: Statutory Look-Up / Cooling-Off Period Duration
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.statutory_rule: The Board-determined cooling-off period shall not be less than one day, regardless of loan tenor.
obligations.remediation_advice: Set a cooling-off period of at least one day for every digital loan.

obligations.title: Zero Prepayment or Foreclosure Charges During Cooling-Off
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.clause: Direction 10(i)-(ii): Exit option and processing fee
obligations.statutory_rule: Borrowers may exit during the cooling-off period by paying principal and proportionate APR without penalty; a reasonable one-time processing fee may be retained if disclosed upfront.
obligations.remediation_advice: Remove penalties; retain only a reasonable one-time processing fee disclosed upfront.

obligations.title: Direct Disbursal and Repayment Prohibition on Pass-Through / Pool Accounts
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.clause: Clause 4.1 & 4.2: Direct Disbursals & Repayments (No Pool Accounts)
obligations.statutory_rule: REs shall ensure that all loan disbursals and repayments are executed directly into the bank account of the borrower without any pass-through or pool account of any third party or LSP.
obligations.remediation_advice: Eliminate routing through third-party or LSP escrow/collection pool accounts. Disburse loan funds directly into borrower bank account.

obligations.title: Prohibition of Biometric Data and Credential Storage
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.statutory_rule: REs shall ensure that no biometric data or raw fingerprint/facial templates are stored or collected on the servers or systems of DLAs or LSPs.
obligations.remediation_advice: Remove all clauses permitting storage or retention of borrower biometric data on DLA or partner servers.

obligations.title: Default Loss Guarantee (DLG) 5% Portfolio Cap
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.statutory_rule: The DLG cover shall not exceed five percent of the total amount disbursed in the underlying loan portfolio.
obligations.remediation_advice: Cap DLG at 5% of the total amount disbursed in the underlying loan portfolio.

obligations.title: Mandatory Key Fact Statement (KFS) Disclosure Before Loan Execution
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.clause: Clause 6.1 & 6.2: Key Fact Statement (KFS) Mandatory Disclosure
obligations.statutory_rule: REs must mandatorily provide a standardised Key Fact Statement (KFS) to the borrower before execution of the loan contract, disclosing the all-inclusive APR, repayment schedule, recovery mechanism, and grievance redressal contact.
obligations.remediation_advice: Ensure the KFS is provided to the borrower before contract execution containing the all-inclusive APR, fees, repayment schedule, and grievance officer contact.

obligations.title: Interest Rate Disclosure and Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Transparency
obligations.circular_name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
obligations.clause: Clause 7.1: Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Disclosure Obligation
obligations.statutory_rule: REs shall ensure complete and upfront disclosure of the Annual Percentage Rate (APR) inclusive of all fees, charges, and cost components. No hidden charges or undisclosed fees may be levied on the borrower.
obligations.remediation_advice: Disclose all fees and charges upfront in the KFS and loan agreement as part of the all-inclusive APR. Remove any provision permitting hidden or undisclosed charges.

obligations.title: V-CIP Video Encryption and Indian Geo-Tagging Standards
obligations.circular_name: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016
obligations.clause: Clause 18 & 27: V-CIP Live Video and Geo-Tagging Standards
obligations.statutory_rule: V-CIP live video interactions must include real-time liveness checks, AES-256 encrypted channels, and verifiable geo-tagging confirming customer physical presence within Indian territory.
obligations.remediation_advice: Incorporate explicit contractual stipulations mandating AES-256 video encryption, active liveness validation, and Indian geo-tagging checks during V-CIP.

obligations.title: Periodic KYC Updation Timeline Schedule
obligations.circular_name: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016
obligations.statutory_rule: Periodic KYC update must be carried out at least once every 2 years for high-risk customers, once every 8 years for medium-risk customers, and once every 10 years for low-risk customers.
obligations.remediation_advice: Align customer KYC review schedules to RBI Section 38 risk tiers: at least every 2 years (high risk), 8 years (medium risk), and 10 years (low risk).

obligations.title: Mandatory 6-Hour Cyber Incident Reporting Timeline
obligations.circular_name: Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank Payment System Operators (PSOs)
obligations.statutory_rule: Payment System Operators must report any cybersecurity incident to CERT-In and RBI within six (6) hours of detection.
obligations.remediation_advice: Amend cybersecurity incident reporting SLA to a maximum of six (6) hours from detection.

obligations.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Mandatory for Digital Payment Access
obligations.circular_name: Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank Payment System Operators (PSOs)
obligations.statutory_rule: PSOs shall implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all customer-facing digital payment transactions and backend administrative access to payment systems.
obligations.remediation_advice: Implement MFA for all digital payment access points. Single-factor (password-only) authentication is prohibited for payment system operator interfaces.
